products_variant_types_check.name: products_variant_types_check
products_variant_types_check.value:
("products"."variant_type_2_id" is null or ("products"."variant_type_id" is not null and "products"."variant_type_2_id" <> "products"."variant_type_id"))
        and ("products"."variant_type_3_id" is null or ("products"."variant_type_2_id" is not null and "products"."variant_type_3_id" not in ("products"."variant_type_id", "products"."variant_type_2_id")))

products_quantities_check.name: products_quantities_check
products_quantities_check.value:
"products"."min_quantity" > 0 and "products"."quantity_step" > 0
        and ("products"."sale_unit" in ('kg', 'm', 'm2', 'l', 'hour') or ("products"."quantity_step" = 1 and "products"."min_quantity" = trunc("products"."min_quantity")))

stock_movements_sign_check.name: stock_movements_sign_check
stock_movements_sign_check.value:
case
        when "stock_movements"."kind" in ('initial', 'purchase', 'return') then "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
        when "stock_movements"."kind" in ('sale', 'loss') then "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
        else "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0 end

orders_text_check.name: orders_text_check
orders_text_check.value: length("orders"."customer_name") between 1 and 80 and length("orders"."notes") <= 500 and length(coalesce("orders"."address", '')) <= 300

sale_receipts_number_check.name: sale_receipts_number_check
sale_receipts_number_check.value: ("sale_receipts"."number" is null) = ("sale_receipts"."code" is null) and coalesce("sale_receipts"."number", 1) >= 1
